programme.desc: Crazy car enthusiast Richard Hammond is back with a new project.He opens a workshop where he will renovate rare classic cars and motorcycles.Hammond knows cars very well, but the business side of the project is black magic for him.Richard risks his money and reputation and ventures far beyond his comfort zone - into a land of demanding customers, unrealistic deadlines and automotive challenges.He is supported in his endeavor by a duo of great mechanics: Neil and Anthony Greenhouse Richard Hammond is fulfilling his long-held dream of starting a company renovating classic cars.The workshop is set up close to home, and the renovation team consists of geniuses in their field, father Neil and son Anthony Greenhouse.Richard promises them that the workshop will soon be filled with prestigious restoration machines, but logistical problems become increasingly difficult to overcome.Not wanting to lose face, Hammond involves his family in promoting the workshop at a car event.However, he suffers a spectacular failure when the Jaguar E-Type he is exhibiting breaks down at an event.
